attributes.name: Body of Flame
attributes.powers: Display this card when you encounter a card. While displayed, for your combat check, you may use your Divine skill + 2d6. This counts as playing a spell. When you encounter a boon that does not have the Fire trait, banish that boon. At the end of the turn, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, you may attempt a Divine 9 check. If you succeed, recharge this card; if you fail, discard it.
